title: Longest Common Prefix
summary: Find the longest string that every word in a list starts with.

tests.explain: All four start with "inter"; at the next position they split into v, n, v and n.
"tr" is shared; then "tree" has e where the others have i.
The first letters already differ, so the common prefix is the empty string.

hints: The common prefix can't be longer than the shortest string, and it ends at the first position where two strings disagree.
In a trie of all the strings, the shared prefix is the path from the root along which there is only one way to go.
Walk down from the root while the current node has exactly one child and no string ends at it. The characters you pass are the answer.

complexity.time: O(S): S is the total number of characters, each inserted once
complexity.space: O(S) for the trie (scanning the strings column by column needs only O(1))
